evals.title: Collective credit and calibrated causality
evidence: apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/google-shared-drives.ts: CLM-NYCAC-MULTI-ACTION-GUIDANCE-DRAFT attributes Jamie’s working revision, preserves the later collaborator edit, and explicitly rejects publication, participation, and policy-outcome claims.

apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/teams-archive.ts: CLM-CRS-COALITION-OPERATING-SYSTEM names Jamie’s design and maintenance actions while describing the minutes as collaborative and rejecting sole-movement, universal-agreement, and legislative-causality claims.

apps/www/src/content/work/fair-rent-nyc.mdx separates Jamie’s direct organizing, web, testimony, and documentation actions from coalition contributions and governmental outcomes, explicitly retaining credit for sponsors, partners, agencies, operators, advocates, and officials.

apps/www/src/data/proofs.ts: kc-town-hall-public-benefit-documentation distinguishes Jamie’s developer/presenter role and first-hand transition statement from Board recommendation, Council appropriation, later withdrawal, and reappropriation; private reasons and unsupported transfer mechanics are excluded.

apps/www/src/content/work/kc-town-hall.mdx presents the project ending candidly, distinguishes the first-hand transition account from official records, and does not expose the receiving organization or private circumstances.
Focused verification passed 21/21 tests, including Shared Drive collaboration boundaries, collective raft scale, Fair Rent adoption limits, and both KC Town Hall chronology tests.
findings: Jamie’s documented actions are stated directly without absorbing collaborator, coalition, or government work into individual authorship.
Draft, publication, adoption, audience response, public outcome, and causality remain distinct throughout the inspected claim and projection layers.
KC Town Hall transition stewardship is legible while official records, unsupported mechanics, and private reasons remain explicitly separated.
evals.recommended_next_move: Retain the current claim-level credit and causality boundaries during future projection edits, especially the collaborator-edit and KC Town Hall transition distinctions.

evals.title: Source-backed strength through Chad's lens
evidence: apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/google-shared-drives.ts: CLM-GDRIVE-PORTABLE-HANDOFF-PRACTICE states direct maintenance actions, intended collaborators, and the usable consequence—people can orient, act, and continue—while bounding the review to 14 of 110 accessible drives.

apps/www/src/data/work.ts and apps/www/src/app/work/technical-operations/page.tsx give hiring readers concrete actions, intended users, operational artifacts, and usable consequences across Fair Rent NYC, 196 / Sunday Dinner, and Technical Operations.
RT-GDRIVE-196-WORKFLOW-REUSE-CORROBORATION keeps repeated use open and separates the single 2023 template from the independently supported 20-plus-resident scale.
RT-GDRIVE-NYCAC-GUIDANCE-PUBLICATION-USE and RT-GDRIVE-ARCHIVE-WORKFLOW-EXECUTION preserve publication/use and execution outcomes as bounded research rather than promoted accomplishments.
CLM-SBU-STYLE-GUIDE-HANDOFF-SEED remains dormant with held projections, while the remaining 96 drives, Sunday Dinner photographs, and WOWList transition material remain purposeful protected research.
The focused evaluator passed the explicit outcome-gap and reusable-drift tests; citation and knowledge-bank checks also exited successfully.
findings: The candidate meets the hiring-legibility criteria: actions are specific, intended users and usable consequences are named, unresolved value remains prioritized, and the difficult KC Town Hall ending is framed without private circumstances.
The exact CLM-196 projections do not call the 2023 template reusable or use it to prove the 20-plus scale.

A minor compositional ambiguity prevents a 4: apps/www/src/data/work.ts describes repeatable participation infrastructure as “including” the newly evidenced handoff, and the 196 MDX places the one-template claim immediately after the aggregate repeatable/20-plus statement. A fast reader could still conflate the evidence paths despite the strong canonical guardrails.
evals.recommended_next_move: In the 196 public composition, add one short sentence explicitly stating that the 2023 artifact demonstrates one handoff instance and does not establish repeated use or the 20-plus scale.
